purpose: Deterministic institutional facility projects. Project records own lifecycle progress only; stock owns resources and the world place registry owns completed facility capability.

rules.resource_payment: All listed stock costs are consumed exactly once when the project starts.
rules.labor: Authorized institutional labor is represented by deterministic work units per active hour. A project does not create a separate population body.
rules.completion: A facility module changes only when accumulated work reaches the required work units.
rules.cancellation: Cancelling stops future work and does not refund already consumed resources.
rules.concurrency: At most one active project of the same type may target the same place.
rules.financial_payment: Each project type also pays its registered ryō cost exactly once at project start from the institution funding account into the contractor economy. Currency is transferred, never destroyed.
rules.facility_prerequisites: A project may declare requires_modules only when another existing mechanical module is genuinely required. No decorative prerequisite module is created merely to unlock a project.
